caseName: Union Bank of Switzerland v. United States
caseNameFull: Union Bank of Switzerland v. United States

opinions.text: Application for stay of mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit, presented to Justice Kennedy, and by him referred to the Court, granted pending the disposition by this Court of the petition for writ of certiorari. Should the petition for writ of certiorari be denied, this stay terminates automatically. In the event the petition for writ of certiorari is granted, this stay shall continue pending the sending down of the judgment of this Court.
